name: Winter Miracle
source:
The world has ended, leaving only snow and silence in its wake. You are one of the lucky few, sheltering in the library of an abandoned Pioneer camp along with a small group of your former students. But survival is taking its toll. The days are short, the cold is biting, and your motivation is slipping away into a deep depression.

Nadya, Slavya, Alisa, Ulyana, and Lyena are doing their best to keep things running, but they are hiding something. They are whispering in corners, sneaking out into the dangerous frost, and taking risks that could cost them everything.

In this short, atmospheric visual novel, discover what keeps a family together when civilization falls apart.
